compiler.content:
PRODUCT FIDELITY RULES (non-negotiable):
- Use the attached reference product image EXACTLY as shown
- Do NOT redraw, recolor, or alter the product appearance in any way
- The product must remain photorealistic and true to the reference

FINANCIAL ACCURACY:
- Show only the price and offer that match the live product page
- Never display cost price or internal margin data
- Discount percentage must match actual MRP vs SP calculation

TEXT AND LAYOUT:
- Keep text within safe zones (10% margin on all edges)
- Ensure text is legible at mobile resolution (minimum 16px equivalent)
- Honour the aspect ratio of the template exactly
- All text slots follow the character limits specified in the template

BANNED ELEMENTS:
- No competitor logos or branding
- No medical or health claims unless in category approved list
- No explicit before/after transformation imagery
- No price manipulation or inflated crossed-out prices

product_hero.content: Product Hero logic: Center the product with clear lighting. Focus on material texture, shine, and craftsmanship. Clean studio environment with minimal distraction.

problem_solution.content: Problem-Solution logic: Establish the relatable pain point or emotional friction in the visual cue or hook line. Provide the product as the effortless, definitive solution.

offer_led.content: Offer-Led logic: Emphasize maximum value perception. High contrast discount badge and pricing clarity, while keeping the product premium and desirable.

lifestyle.content: Lifestyle logic: Place the product in authentic, aspirational day-to-day settings. Focus on emotion, aesthetic mood, and natural styling.

ugc_style.content: UGC Style logic: Relatable customer perspective. Handheld composition, warm authentic lighting, conversational review tone.

gifting.content: Gifting logic: Emotional resonance around special moments, thoughtful presentation, gift box unboxing aesthetics.

Jewellery.content: Jewellery Pack: Emphasize 925 sterling silver stamp, rhodium shine, anti-tarnish coating, skin-safe hypoallergenic properties. Props: velvet trays, marble slabs, soft silk fabric, warm directional light.

Fashion.content: Fashion Pack: Emphasize fabric texture, drape, fit versatility, breathable weave. Props: architectural arches, neutral backdrops, daylight studio.

Beauty & Personal Care.content: Beauty Pack: Clean dermatological look, hydration droplets, ingredient botanical cues, fresh morning light.

Home & Kitchen.content: Home Pack: Cozy modern living space, functional kitchen counter, ambient warmth, durable utility.

default.content: Default Pack: Clean modern product showcase, studio gradient background, high-contrast typography, premium lighting.
